domain.description: Your helpdesk address without https://, e.g. holtzbrinckpublishersllc.freshdesk.com

api_key.description: Used only to list groups, ticket types, portals and fields in the rule editor. Find it under Profile settings > View API key.

editors.description: Comma-separated agent emails allowed to change rules. Leave empty to let any agent who opens the editor change them.

debug.description: For testing only: every ticket shows a pop-up saying what Field Rules decided to hide or require. Turn off when done.
